pdk_provenance.scope: Public pinned PDK; numerical interconnect assumptions are separately labelled.

before.method: ordinary least squares, free intercept, all passing measured widths
before.scope: Nominal deterministic samples, not PVT confidence bounds or unmeasured-width predictions. Power per cell is an effective average for this adder mix and documented-state maximum. Resistive dividers draw DC at idle; frequency reduction alone does not remove that current.

after.scope: Nominal deterministic samples, not PVT confidence bounds or unmeasured-width predictions. Power per cell is an effective average for this adder mix and documented-state maximum. Resistive dividers draw DC at idle; frequency reduction alone does not remove that current.

comparison_scope: Pre-wire baseline now uses exactly the extracted intrinsic devices. Wire-C no-op bug corrected. Geometry also changes to reserve PNR current margin; old/new differences are not PDK R/C coefficient updates.
